description_markdown:
### Local LLM Offline Evaluation & Prompt Regression Benchmark Suite

Deterministic offline prompt regression benchmarking harness for Ollama, vLLM, and llama.cpp. Zero cloud API dependencies — operates 100% locally on your VPC or machine.

Includes 100+ prompt regression vectors, latency TTFT profiler, strict schema drift scorecards, and lifetime updates.
